Procurement Plan
Purpose
The purpose of the procurement plan is to provide an initial planning document and an overall
control document for purchase order and subcontract names and numbers.
The procurement plan is owned and maintained by purchasing, however responsibilities for
specific information rests with others as specified below.  For construction subcontracts,
engineering subcontracts and inspection services, Construction, Project Manger/Project
Engineer (PM/PE) and Quality Assurance respectively are responsible for ensuring this information
is entered and maintained
This document is a template and can be revised to suit project specific requirements.  Care
should be taken to ensure that the intent of the document as a planning and coordination tool
is maintained.  Reporting should be done from the relevant system i.e. Procurement System.
Purchase Order Name and Number
Developed by the Purchasing in consultation with the disciplines, construction and PM/PE.
Maintained by the Purchasing.
The name and number as listed will be used in all procurement related references including:

column2: Project Directory Structure and subdirectory names
Email Project Folder and subfolder names

column1: Equipment Name and Number
From the mechanical or electrical equipment list.  Used to plan the content of PO's.
For piping, include pipe specification
For instruments, include quantity of instruments planned.
Assigned and maintained by the discipline.
Order Status
R - RFQ Issued
P - PO Issued
Assigned and maintained by Purchasing.
Bidder/Vendors
Assigned and maintained by Purchasing.
Include preferred vendors required by contract.  Other vendors to be identified through review
with the disciplines and PM/PE.  May be used for bidder approval from client.  Formal bid list
and record of bidders is maintained in the procurement database and the RFQ report.
Once order is placed, Purchasing will replace bidders name with selected vendor.
Factory Location. Delivery and Date
These are used for initial project planning and scheduling including preliminary schedule, logistics
plan and identifying schedule critical orders. Delivery is expected weeks ARO.  On site is
the estimated required on site date. This column can be changed to shipment number when
the contract requires delivery of goods to port in specific shipments.
Procurement will update Factory Location and Delivery when PO is issued.
Project Controls will update required on site date.
Priority
Procurement Priority 1, 2, 3, 4 as defined in PEM. Assigned and maintained by Purchasing in
consultation with the PM/PE.
Terms
One of the following identifying type of order:
L - PO, Long form T&C's
S - PO, short form T&C's
A - Service Agreement
E - Engineering Subcontract
C - Construction Subcontract
When the Owner is placing the order, the letter above with be preceeded by the letter "O".
Assigned and maintained by Purchasing
Inspection Level
Q/A inspection level as defined in 0-SPC-0001 and 0-SPC-0002.
Assigned and maintained by Q/A
Estimated Value and Budget Currency
Estimated value for indication of order size.  Budgeted currency to identify foreign exchange
impacts.    These values are not intended for cost control or bid tab purposes.
Assigned and maintained by Purchasing in consultation with the PM/PE.
Comments/Risks/Guarantees
Comments including any contractual risks associated with the order including LD's, need for
process or other guarantees including need to back-to-back contract guarantees or LD's
Assigned and maintained by Purchasing in consultation with the PM/PE.
